title: dubuk yan widirih uduurra
intro: annals divine favor, toh rooci qeedaalisso sinni saytunaane, baxsa luk ken ummattak dubuh yan num gorrisuh diini afkanal. Dagoom oson yaaxigeenih too sittin way baahele asta inkih tan baadal, imaan gibbatuy amotani yaabimele.
clues: Anu ubkak naharal ayfaafay manoh gulguluh suge.
Anu massakaxxa le nabiyyih dacrisah gubat daffeyseh suge.
Anu yi dacrisah cakkumsuteh yan Yallih gabat rizqit suge.
Anu inni buxah marak ayro mawqah arac fan gexe.
Inki malayka qigduk yan numih weelol yol tumbulleeh, saytun baxi xaagu bahta.
Anu qusba yooboke alqi lih uduure wak, yi ummatta yoo malkisseh, takkay immay alqi yi kalaluh yaabe.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Qajiibik tan mablaa kee baxi ubka
trial.answer: Qajiibik tan mablaa kee baxi ubka

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
